planRows.shortDesc: Two blocks off the downtown square, we put the best of Northwest Arkansas at your doorstep. Enjoy bike valet and storage while you explore the area's world-famous mountain biking. Crystal Bridges Museum and The Momentary are within two miles. And our modern sushi restaurant is inspired by Japanese listening bars.
planRows.headline: Your hub for creativity and adventure
planRows.locationShortDesc: Just south of the Bentonville square, Motto by Hilton Bentonville Downtown is your launchpad to explore some of the city’s best offerings.
planRows.directionsTo:
From NW Airport Regional Airport (XNA), follow Airport Blvd to Regional Ave for one mile. Turn right onto AR-12 E/SW Regional Airport Blvd continue for seven miles then take a sharp left onto S Walton Blvd, continue for one mile, then right on SW A St. Turn right onto SW Henry St., then turn right onto S Main St.  The Motto by Hilton Bentonville Downtown will be located on your left.

From Walmart Corporate Offices, head east toward SW F St.  Turn left onto SW F St., then turn right onto SW 6th St. Turn left onto SW E St., continue for half a mile, then turn right onto SW 2nd St. Continue for half a mile then turn right onto S Main St. The Motto by Hilton Bentonville Downtown will be located on your left.

From Rogers Convention Center, head north toward S Pinnacle Hills Pkwy. Merge onto I-49 N and continue for 7 miles.  Take exit 86 for AR-102 W toward Bentonville and turn left onto AR-102 W/SE 14th St for two miles.  Turn right onto SE C St. for one mile, then turn left onto SE 3rd St. Turn right onto S Main St. The Motto by Hilton Bentonville Downtown will be located on your left.

planRows.shortDesc: Find us in Cusco's Historic Center, an area rich with historic sites, dining options, and modern amenities. The Plaza de Armas and Cusco Cathedral are within two blocks, and we're three blocks from the Temple of the Sun, Koricancha. The airport is six kilometers away. Enjoy our bar and public spaces, designed with inspiration from the Inca culture.
planRows.headline: Ancient wonders and modern charms
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located at Calle Ruinas 502, in the city of Cusco, 7 minutes walking distance to the Cusco main square.
planRows.directionsTo: From Airport take calle Velasco Astete then Av. 28 de Julio until you get to ovalo Pachacuteq, then calle San Martin until you get to Calle Tullumayu, go straight and will cross calle ruinas N° 502 (where the Hotel is Located). around 20 minutes.

planRows.shortDesc: We’re centered in Guadalajara’s downtown, minutes from historical sites, architecture, local culture, and monuments. Degollado Theater, Guadalajara Cathedral, and Cabañas Cultural Institute are within one kilometer. Guadalajara International Airport is 38 minutes away. Enjoy on-site dining and our coffee shop - all inspired by local flavors.
planRows.headline: Close to downtown attractions
planRows.locationShortDesc: Located in the historical center of the city, we're near the Degollado Theater, Cathedral, and the most important landmark buildings.
planRows.directionsTo: Take the Chapala-Guadalajara highway and drive on it until you reach the intersection with Lazaro Cardenas Avenue, crossing the intersection the highway changes name to Calzada Jess Gonzalez Gallo, continue on it until you reach the intersection with Calzada del Ejercito, turn right on Calzada del Ejercito, continue on Calzada del Ejercito until the intersection with Constancia Street, on Constancia Street turn right and continue on it until you reach the intersection with Javier Mina Avenue, at Javier Mina turn left and drive on it, crossing Calzada Independencia, Javier Mina changes name to Avenida Juarez, continue on Avenida Juarez until the intersection with Degollado Street, turn right in Degollado Street, continue on it until the intersection with Pedro Moreno Street and turn to the right, continue for 100 meters on Pedro Moreno and you will find the hotel entrance on the left sidewalk.

We’re about 100 meters from Marco Zero Square, and Recife Expo Center is a five-minute drive away. The Historic Centre of Olinda is within eight kilometers, and a UNESCO World Heritage site. Enjoy our locally inspired design and views from our rooftop bar.

planRows.shortDesc: Find us in Hunab Lifestyle Center, Tulum’s shopping and dining destination, near recognized cenotes and in front of Jaguar National Park. The city center, with local handmade goods, is 10 minutes away. The Mayan ruins and beaches are within five kilometers. We offer two rooftop pools with jungle views. Enjoy our fitness center or a massage at our spa.
planRows.headline: Inspired spaces near Mayan ruins
planRows.locationShortDesc: Motto Hotel is located next to Hunab mall at Aldea Zama district, at the “Pueblo mágico” of Tulum.
planRows.directionsTo: The Hotel it´s located south of the Mayan Riviera, just a few meters from the Tulum-Cancún federal highway and just 5 minutes from the Mexican Caribbean beach and the Tulum Mayan ruins. It merges 79 miles to the north with Cancún and 162 miles to the south with Chetumal, the state capital city. It Adjoins northwest with the archaeological ruins of Cobá and Valladolid.
